response.overview: Negatives on Paper: Talbot’s Process is one of three short films on early photographic processes made by James Card, commissioned for use as an exhibition and educational tool prior to the George Eastman Museum’s opening in 1949. The short film provides an in depth examination of the technical precision required of photographers in the 19th century.  Available to watch through the museum’s online resources: https://www.eastman.org/negatives-paper-talbots-process
response.title: Negatives on Paper: Talbot’s Process
